title: Planet Labs PBC Q1 fiscal 2027 results
excerpt: Q1 revenue was USD 94.2 million, recurring ACV was 99%, RPO was USD 816 million, backlog exceeded USD 906 million, and cash plus short-term investments was USD 730.8 million.
summary: The SEC-filed Q1 release confirms 42% revenue growth, high recurring ACV, stronger RPO and backlog, near-break-even adjusted EBITDA, positive operating cash flow, negative free cash flow, and FY2027 revenue guidance of USD 425-441 million.
